title: Komorebi Space: Completion Plan after v1.14.0
status: Proposed completion plan; no new proofs or release edits executed in this planning review.

baseline.calibration: The principal theorem conclusions are established under their stated hypotheses. This is not a claim that every alternative printed proof, illustration, or Python implementation is formalized.

recommendation: Freeze the mathematical scope. Add two small formal corollaries connecting existing results, finish integrated reproducibility, add a short existing-example crosswalk and reuse metadata, then verify the actually distributed files and freeze the next edition.

work.printed_source: source/chapters/05k_stopping_rules.tex, Retaining the explicit diagonal rate with an inexact solver
work.contract: For 0 < delta <= 1, kappa >= 0, m = ceil(delta^(-2/3)), alpha = m^(-2), measured data within delta, and measured normal residual <= epsilon <= kappa * alpha * delta^(1/3), prove norm(a-a_dagger) <= (sqrt(2)+1+kappa)*delta^(1/3). Preserve the actual infinite Hilbert model and literal ceiling.
work.classification: Printed consequence of already formalized results, not an unresolved principal theorem.

work.contract: For the existing diagonal T on the actual square-summable Hilbert space, instantiate the unit-vector witnesses and prove its range is not closed. Do not claim the entire protected product-space example is thereby formalized.
work.optional_endpoint: Membership of the escaping datum in closure(range T) but not range T, only if obtained directly from the same checked instance.

planning_review.source_inspection: Read-only review of current monograph boundaries, correspondence appendices, stopping-rule and geometry examples, Lean APIs, usage instructions, existing Python examples and reuse metadata.

definition_of_done: A reader can unpack the release, identify what is proved and what remains outside scope, reproduce the declared project checks through one documented route, run an existing example and connect its certificate to the mathematics, and identify the author, reuse terms and exact file versions. New research ambitions are not prerequisites for this completion.
